title: Ultra-Dex Interactive Tutorial
description: Learn Ultra-Dex features in 10 easy steps

steps.title: Welcome to Ultra-Dex
steps.description: Introduction to the AI orchestration platform
steps.explanation: Ultra-Dex is an AI orchestration meta-layer that coordinates agents, models, memory, and tools.

steps.title: Check Your Setup
steps.explanation: This command shows your Ultra-Dex version.
steps.challenge: Run the command and verify you see version 6.0.0

steps.title: View Available Commands
steps.explanation: This shows all available commands and options.
steps.challenge: Find the 'run' command and its description

steps.title: Initialize a Project
steps.description: Set up Ultra-Dex in your current directory
steps.explanation: This creates configuration files and prepares your environment.
steps.challenge: Run init and observe the configuration created

steps.title: Configure AI Providers
steps.description: Set up your AI model providers
steps.explanation: This guides you through setting up OpenAI, Anthropic, or other providers.
steps.challenge: Start the wizard (you can exit without saving)

steps.title: Run Your First Task
steps.description: Execute a simple task with Ultra-Dex
steps.command: ultra-dex run --task "Say hello to the world"
steps.explanation: This sends a task to the AI orchestrator.
steps.challenge: Run a simple task of your choice

steps.title: Check Status
steps.description: View the status of your orchestrator
steps.explanation: This shows the current state of agents and memory.
steps.challenge: Run the status command and observe the output

steps.title: Explore Agents
steps.explanation: This shows all available specialized agents (planner, cto, backend, etc.)
steps.challenge: Identify at least 3 different agent types

steps.title: View Memory
steps.explanation: This shows information stored in Ultra-Dex's tiered memory system.
steps.challenge: Observe the memory tiers (hot, warm, cold)

steps.title: Complete Tutorial
steps.explanation: You now know the basics of Ultra-Dex. Explore advanced features!
steps.challenge: Try creating a more complex task using multiple agents
